cohort_policy: Derived cohorts separate scalar/vector APIs, 2D/3D inputs and image pixel counts: tiny<200, small200..4095, large>=4096. All995 frozen source cases, eight readonly errors and aliases are untimed. Every timed case is an allocation/reset-inclusive warmed public call.

linux-minimum.runtime_evidence: All archived15Windows/14Linux runtime input wheels and RECORDs verified, with four installed package trees/three dependency library trees/sourceZIP/Git/59SDK seals. Other dependencies have installed version pins and archived wheel hashes. Initialdefault1 and sole shared worker API asserted before fixtures; default telemetry1 serialized. Four alias identities are serialized; alias value comparisons execute in source but are not separately serialized. Actual public wrappers and owned compiled entries are source-audited; this R4 harness does not install the later R5/R6 untimed anti-forward profiler.
linux-minimum.scope: Warmed public calls; supplied output reset/allocation/destruction included. Fixture construction excluded. Errors/metadata/aliases untimed.
